title: Your Home Can Survive a Wildfire
summary: NFPA video in which wildfire researcher Jack Cohen explains that embers (firebrands), not the flame front, are the main cause of homes igniting in wildfires. He shows how landscaping and removing debris around the home reduce risk.
why: HN commenters cite it as a source for the research showing that simple home-ignition-zone measures raise a house's chance of surviving a wildfire.

quote.text: the fire scientists at (e.g.) the USDA Forest Service have been doing research on this for many years
